### workspace deactivate --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace deactivate [options] [project]

Deactivate Claude in a project's tmux pane by sending Ctrl-C.
Auto-detects the project from the current directory if not specified.

Options:
        --all                        Deactivate Claude in all active projects
        --json                       Print one action document (see docs/README.json.md) instead of text, which goes to stderr

Examples:
  workspace deactivate my-project    # deactivate Claude in a specific project
  workspace deactivate    # auto-detected from the current directory
  workspace deactivate --all    # deactivate Claude in all active projects
--- stderr
--- end
